issue.title: Unify console color handling
issue.body:
- quarkus.console.color is now the canonical source of color
- quarkus.logging.console.color is now deprecated (same as
  quarkus.test.disable-color)
- If color is disable the advanced ANSI console will also be disabled

Previously color was only the concern of logging, but now that we have
the continuous testing console it also matters for the testing console.

Fixes #18288

body: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/18506 should fix it, I will boot into windows later today to test it.

So the linked PR fixes the color, but it won't add the proper console, as the plugin does not run inside a real terminal.

If you do mvn quarkus:dev in the intellij terminal you will get the full terminal experience.
